entries.en: Yusuke's painting won the competition...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I still have much to learn,[n]but I finally painted something[n]that I can be satisfied with.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. This is the true heart of humanity.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The title is "Desire and Hope."[n]What do you think?
It turned out well.
So you added hope?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I added aspects that were previously[n]lacking.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This light... is all of you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The title lists hope, but in my mind,[n]it's a much more concrete thing.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can't believe I didn't realize that[n]until now...

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You...

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: ...It's a good painting.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: It's not trying to be eccentric for[n]the sake of being eccentric, like[n]the last time.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: To think the same painting can[n]change this much...

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: So this is the answer[n]you've come up with?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...It is.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: "Desire and Hope"... I see. Beauty and[n]ugliness... Humans are creatures that[n]possess both.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: It seems you understand that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What are you playing at?
You provoked Yusuke on purpose?
Are you scheming something?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I suppose I can't blame[n]you for thinking that.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I apologize. Although my intent was[n]to encourage you, it WAS rather crude.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do you mean?[n]Weren't you backing another?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Oh, that?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: The strong-spirited rookie[n]that I was supporting...

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: ...is him.
What are you talking about?
This was all an act?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Well, I suppose you can say that.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Still, I believed that this ploy[n]needed to be done in order to[n]ignite your competitive spirit.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But... why would you do that?[n]What's your objective?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I wanted to do something for you[n]as another person who is free from[n]Madarame's chains. That's all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Madarame held a grudge against[n]me for supposedly stealing his[n]customers from him.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: To start, I couldn't get anyone[n]to rent me space for exhibits...[n]He caused me no end of hardship.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So that's why...

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Yes... The heart of man is painted[n]with desire, even if it's coated[n]entirely in black at times.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: However, it seems you have the[n]strength to not look away from it,[n]and chose to stand up against it.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: If only he had your strength...
"He"?
Do you mean Madarame?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: ...Madarame and I go back a long[n]way. First as classmates, then as[n]teachers at the same art school.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: He used to have a noble spirit.[n]Said he wanted to aim for the top[n]of the art world one day.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: But in the end, even the art[n]world has its share of politics...[n]Those who are cunning win.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Our hearts were stained[n]black in that manner.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: But the human heart is a strange[n]thing. It can't completely[n]separate black from white.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I was shocked when I heard[n]that he took you in. He never[n]liked children, you see.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Oh?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: This happened just before we[n]cut all ties from each other,[n]but I got a call from him.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: He was panicking that nearby[n]clinics were closed and that[n]his kid had a fever.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sensei...
He was a good man deep down.[clr 27]
That was another aspect of him.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I don't want any more losers like[n]me or misguided winners like him[n]being born from this world.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: That's why I started this foundation.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: So how about it?[n]Would you like our support?

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Without the overbearing marketing[n]production, of course.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's a truly kind offer...[n]Thank you for your generosity.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...However, I must respectfully decline.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Huh. What makes you say that?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I am not Madarame.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I won't be stained by desire.[n]After all, I can see hope.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If I am lost, they will extend[n]their hands. If I am wrong,[n]they will chastise me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...As long as I have my rays of[n]hope to guide me, I will be fine.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: ...Hah. Madarame really did[n]have a good eye. Hahahahaha!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What a strange man...
Yeah...
You're stranger, Yusuke.
Are you sure about this?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sacrificing one's own money for[n]the sake of others—that's not[n]something anyone can do.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps it's a tad wasteful of me to decline.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: For declining his offer?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It IS a tad wasteful of me to decline.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It IS a tad wasteful of me to decline.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Still, I believe it's for the best.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I feel contradictory, but that's[n]the human heart, correct?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Interesting. That's exactly[n]what I should be painting.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It must have been troublesome[n]dealing with me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But for some reason, I knew that[n]you wouldn't abandon me until[n]everything was said and done.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thank you... my friend.
I feel a strong bond with Yusuke...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The Persona within me has[n]awakened to a new power.
Yusuke's Persona [clr 1]Goemon[clr 27] has[n]transformed into [clr 2]Kamu Susano-o[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now that I'm out of my slump,[n]I need to make up for the[n]time I wasn't able to paint.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I reiterate my promise to you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll extend my assistance to[n]you, should you ever stumble.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now then, shall we go?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In order for me to learn more[n]about the heart, we need to work[n]hard in our thief business.
